[Context] Delivery opening — the machine arrives. Brand new, factory-shrink-wrapped feel.
[Visual] An XCMG XE17U compact mini-excavator sitting brand-new on a heavy timber delivery pallet, just off the truck. The yellow paintwork is immaculate and glossy with a faint highlight sheen, a small factory sticker still on the cab window, tracks pristine and unscuffed. Industrial unloading moment — the corner of a delivery truck tail visible at the right edge of frame, two heavy-duty forklift tines just engaging the front of the pallet. Cardboard packaging strips at the base. Clean warehouse-loading-bay floor underneath. Soft indoor light from above and one side. Sense of the reveal moment — the machine arrives.

[Style] B&W storyboard sketch on cream paper, hyperreal sketch detail on the machine and the pallet, industrial documentary mood. No colour, no text.

[Context] The old-school workaround — the founders are mid-attempt at covering the machine the bush-mechanic way: throwing a tarp over it, clipping ocky straps. Comically inadequate.
[Visual] Worksite floor. Luke (cap, dark moustache) on the LEFT side of the XE17U excavator, Joel (chevron moustache, no cap) on the RIGHT side. They are mid-action together, wrangling a sagging olive-green canvas tarp UP and OVER the operator cab — the tarp is wrinkled and ill-fitting, sliding off one corner already, clearly never designed for this purpose. Luke holding one corner of the tarp up over his head, his other hand reaching down with a black rubber ocky strap, the hook just about to clip onto the chassis. Joel has a second ocky strap stretched taut across the boom, mid-clip on the other end. Slight grimace of frustration on Joel's face. Bush-fix energy. The cab is mostly covered but the tarp is obviously inadequate.
[Format] 9:16 vertical, single composition.
[Style] B&W storyboard sketch on cream paper, documentary action-mid-moment energy, hyperreal sketch detail on the wrinkled tarp and the ocky-strap rubber. No colour, no text.

The pins are dense around the major capitals (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide) and scatter outward across rural and remote areas including the Pilbara, Top End, Far North Queensland, central NSW, the Mallee, the Riverina, southern Tasmania.
